notes: This contract pins the official C++ surfaces used by the bounded ownership-transfer/update-region scenario. It verifies only Requirements-Lab signatures, declared exception sets, adapter symbols, and a real Catch2 selector. The implementation-specific rule under test is that an explicit update-region association is cleared when ownership moves from the former owner and must be recreated by the new owner before regional reflection resumes. The contract does not claim complete ownership arbitration, all transfer forms, regional callback advisories, transport, packaging, protected evidence, or conformance.
